name: Astemizole

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 14 other countries, first in 1998 — for heart harm

summary: Astemizole was removed from the market in the United States and 14 other countries starting in 1998 because of damage to the heart [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 56 for the liver [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a high risk score of 97 for the heart [M].
